purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: The City of Zürich publishes official cadastral-survey open data and the Canton of Zürich provides a machine-readable AV WFS. GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType confirm the `ms:liegenschaften_f` parcel layer with MultiSurface geometry and safe cadastral keys `nbident`, `nummer`, and `egris_egrid`; unstable system object IDs and unrelated fields were excluded. Exact-point and bounded surrounding WFS queries returned no features, so parcel geometry at the ranked locator is not verified. The official WFS and parcel-layer schema are public and safe fields are known. Exact point, earlier small boxes, a native EPSG:2056 ±100 m box and a standard EPSG:4326 (latitude,longitude) ±100 m box all returned HTTP 200 empty FeatureCollections; no polygon was available to retain at the locator.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official WFS schema and layer advertised extent were reviewed; the WUP point is within the advertised WGS84 bounding box. A federal transform yielded LV95 EPSG:2056 E=2682900.8094122503, N=1248481.086045864. Exact and bounded safe-key requests in native EPSG:2056 and official-axis EPSG:4326 returned HTTP 200 with zero features. No geometry is retained; no citywide completeness claim.
